# PeerFix

> Productized service for indie builders: landing page redesigns, AI automation setup, and technical SEO. One request at a time, async.

## What PeerFix offers

- Landing page redesigns (messaging, hierarchy, CTA, visual polish)
- AI automation setup (form routing, simple agent workflows, MCP-friendly surfaces)
- Technical SEO foundations (schema, meta, structure, Core Web Vitals)
- Monthly unlimited queue or fixed-price 7-day sprint

## Model

- Monthly: $1,995/mo — unlimited requests, one at a time, pause anytime
- Sprint: $1,495 — one full landing page redesign in 7 days
- Async delivery, average under 48 hours for most tasks
- Built for indie SaaS, AI tools, and post-hackathon projects

## Key pages

- / — productized service homepage
- /problems — (legacy) problem marketplace still available
- /expert — (legacy) expert application
